info.longName: iShares ESG Select Screened S&P Mid-Cap ETF

funds_data.description: The fund seeks to track the investment results of the S&P MidCap 400 Sustainability Screened Index, which measures the performance of the mid-capitalization sector of the U.S. equity market while excluding companies involved in controversial business activities and controversies, as determined by S&P Dow Jones Indices LLC. BFA uses a representative sampling indexing strategy to manage the fund. It is non-diversified.
